subject: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot
messages:
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegrate.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 09:14:30 -0700
Subject: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot

Hi Liam / Priya —

Great to meet you both yesterday. As discussed, I sketched a short mutual action plan (MAP) that surfaces the security/compliance gates Fintegrate flagged: SOC 2 evidence, SIG/CAIQ, DPA (data processing), and data retention/segregation expectations.

High-level proposed timeline (pilot):
- Week 0 (this week): Exchange baseline docs (we'll send SOC 2 summary + SIG answers; you share specific CAIQ items you need)
- Week 1: Technical evaluation (sandbox access, sample workloads) + security deep-dive call with our security engineer
- Week 2: DPA redline window / procurement kickoff
- Week 3: POC acceptance, confirm retention settings and logging (audit evidence)
- Week 4: Close / sign + schedule dedicated capacity provisioning (if applicable)

I attached a one-page MAP and our SOC 2 summary to accelerate reviews. Can you confirm:
1) Are the above milestones workable for your procurement/security teams?
2) Which specific SIG/CAIQ sections are must-haves for your legal/security reviewers?

Next steps: I can set up a 45-minute security walkthrough early next week with Karthik and Evelyn from our side.

Thanks,

—
David Kim
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
[Attachment: Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]
[Attachment: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (application/pdf)]
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegrate.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintegrate.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 11:03:10 -0400
Subject: Re: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot

David —

Thanks for the clear MAP. A couple quick items from our side:

- SOC 2: We require a current SOC 2 Type II report (or an AICPA bridge letter if report is >6 months old) before we enable production-facing keys. Your summary is helpful but we'll need the report for procurement.
- SIG/CAIQ: Security wants CAIQ sections for Data Protection, Cryptography, and Logging/Monitoring. If you have a completed CAIQ export, please send; otherwise we will send our prioritized checklist.
- DPA: Our legal team will want to see a DPA that includes subprocessor list and breach notification timelines (48 hours).
- Data retention: We need the ability to set per-namespace retention to 90 days for PII sample data and confirm KV cache eviction behavior.

Timeline-wise the schedule looks fine but procurement will likely ask for a short contract review window (5 business days) once the DPA and SOW are shared.

Can the SOC 2 report and a CAIQ export be shared by EOD Friday (24 Jul)? That will keep us on the Week 1 technical eval.

Regards,
Liam
Head of Integrations, Fintegrate Capital
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegrate.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintegrate.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 22 Jul 2026 13:20:05 -0700
Subject: Re: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot

Liam — thanks, noted. Quick update and attachments:

- Attached: Redwood_SOC2_Summary.pdf (summary + control-owner list) — we can provide the SOC 2 Type II report under NDA / secure link.
- Attached: Fintegrate_MAP_v1.xlsx — I updated the MAP to include your procurement windows and the 5-business-day contract review.
- CAIQ: We maintain a current CAIQ export; sending via secure Share (link below) is preferred for auditability. If you prefer email, we can attach a redacted CAIQ.

On retention and KV cache: per-namespace retention controls are supported for Dedicated and Private deployments; for Hosted API we can scope request/response retention for the pilot to 90 days and demonstrate log retention and deletion flows during the security walkthrough. Evelyn will own the technical demo.

Next steps I propose:
1) I will request SOC2 report access via our secure artifact portal and share the link by EOD Thursday (23 Jul).
2) Karthik will circulate a DPA draft (for initial internal review) by tomorrow morning so you have something to redline.
3) Set security walkthrough: Thu 24 Jul or Mon 28 Jul — please confirm preferred slot.

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegrate.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintegrate.com>
Cc: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn.hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 23 Jul 2026 09:05:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot

Folks — looping in legal/ops. Draft DPA attached (Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx). A few notes up front:

- Subprocessors: current list included at end of doc; we'll highlight any customerspecific requests and track them in the MAP.
- Breach notification: we are willing to commit to 48-hour notification for confirmed incidents; investigative windows are referenced in Section 4.
- Data retention: proposed default (hosted) is 180 days for non-PII logs; per-namespace PII retention can be set to 90 days for a pilot as described. We called out retention controls and API for deletions in Section 7.
- Evidence: we'll map SOC 2 controls to CAIQ in an appendix for clarity.

Please review redlines inline and send back by Mon 27 Jul for procurement to hit Week 2 review.

[Attachment: Redwood_DPA_Draft.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Head of Security & Trust Operations, Redwood Inference
From: Liam O'Connor <liam.oconnor@fintegrate.com>
To: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Shah <priya.shah@fintegrate.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 16:42:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compliance gates + MAP proposal for Fintegrate pilot

Appreciate the fast turnaround — this looks good. Two quick asks before we lock the MAP and kick procurement: 

1) SOC 2: We will accept secure access to the Type II report (NDA already in place). Please share the portal link + access instructions.
2) DPA: We'll review Karthik's draft and return a set of redlines by Mon 27 Jul. Key redline focus will be subprocessor visibility and a 48-hour breach notification SLA (we'll mark language we want firm).

Assuming those are delivered, we can run the technical evaluation next week (24–31 Jul) and target POC acceptance by 13 Aug. Can you confirm Redwood's provisioning lead time for Dedicated capacity if we need it post-POC?

I'll consolidate procurement's prioritized CAIQ questions and send them tomorrow.

Best,
Liam O'Connor
Head of Integrations, Fintegrate Capital
